# Third-party notices

Everything this environment fetches, builds on or runs that it did not write, one row per pin. The environment's own files are MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 lodmaome ([LICENSE](../../LICENSE)).

**How this was written.** Every licence below was read from a file (the file and its revision or URL are in the table) on 2026-10-09. Nothing comes from memory and nothing from an earlier conversation.
The SPDX column is my reading of the text I read; where the text does not settle a version (the GPL files say "version 3" but not "only" or "or later"), the cell says so. This is a record of what was read, not a legal opinion.
The release gate requires a row for every key in `env/pins.env` and `env/gate/tools.env` that carries the key and the first 12 hex characters of the pinned digest or commit, so a pin bump with a stale row fails the gate.

**Fetched at build or run, not redistributed.** The repository contains none of the upstream source. Images are built or pulled locally by the person who runs the stack. "Redistributed" below means the content ends up inside an image that this environment builds on the user's machine.

## Not covered

- **npm packages bundled into the frontend** (from the frontend's `bun.lock`): not inventoried. The built bundle contains them; their licences were not read.
- **Debian and Alpine packages** in the images: not inventoried (they are unpinned, ADR 0001 section 2).
- **The Hurl runner and the RealWorld Hurl suite** used in Phase 1 and Milestone 1 measurements are not part of this repository and are not listed here.
- **Google Fonts and Ionicons** are loaded by the frontend page from their CDNs at view time (`index.html`); no licence was read for them.
